messages:
Alex: Heads-up — Acme demo dry run Wednesday 10:00am PT. Goal: rehearse joint perf readout + press-screen capture. Can we lock script and speakers by Tue EOD?
Maria: OK locking speakers: Alex opens, Leo (AcmeHW) gives partner segment, Jess does Console walk-through, Sam handles live metrics.
Chen: I'll land kernel tuning branch 'acme-demo-v3' today. Expect subtle latency wins at long seqs.
Sam: What models and payloads are we running? Need batch sizes for throughput table.
Alex: Primary: redwood/quant-3b, secondary: community/8b-INT4 for fallback. Workloads: 1) steady 2048 seq, 2) spike 4096 seq sim (10s bursts). Batch sizes: 8 for 2048, 2 for 4096 in the plan.
Leo (AcmeHW): We'll attach external wattmeter and share per-run .csv. We'll also stream telemetry to your ingest endpoint. Confirm endpoint URL?
Maria: Use Console ingest path /partners/acme/telemetry. Jess — can you add widgets for power/watt, p50/p99 latency, token/s?
Jess: On it. Quick question about metric names: are they 'power.watts' and 'inference.tokens_per_sec'?
Sam: Yes those names. Also add 'kernel.version' tag so we can diff v2 vs v3.
Chen: Kernel branch name already includes version tag. I'll also put a brief changelog in the PR: kernel tweaks + KV cache eviction tweak.
Alex: Runbook items: 1) start monitoring, 2) do warmup 10k tokens, 3) run steady 30min, 4) run spike burst run 5x, 5) collect wattmeter csv, 6) snapshot console dashboards. Everyone confirm.
Leo (AcmeHW): Confirmed. We'll send technician for wattmeter calibration Tue morning.
Maria: Press/announce cadence: we agreed internal dry run only. No external screenshots until legal signs off. Tag: @legal-review will get the draft after Tue.
Sam: I'll prepare a short script for the demo runner with fallback to CPU-reserved pool if the dedicated nodes flake.
Chen: Suggest adding a quick kernel-flip rollback step in the runbook: git checkout acme-demo-v2 && restart-inference. I'll add the command.
Alex: Nice. Add a short CLI snippet in the runbook please.
Jess: Dashboard done, saved as 'Acme demo — rehearsal'. Sharing link in thread after this.
RunbookBot: Reminder queued — runbook review meeting Tue 4:30pm PT (15m).
Alex: Perfect. Last ask — can someone prepare a 1-slide slide with throughput/power table we can paste into the press kit? Minimal numbers (mean token/s, mean watts, perf/W).
Sam: I'll draft the slide and post it Tue morning.
Leo (AcmeHW): We'll bring our internal perf/W baseline for the same model to compare.
Alex: Great — thanks team. If anything blocks, ping here. :raised_hands:
